item_short_desc: Rothco’s AR-7 Sport Glasses are designed for those who need reliable eye protection with a lightweight and comfortable fit. Featuring a durable polycarbonate lens and frame, these sunglasses offer optimal clarity and UV protection for outdoor activities. The wide 16 CM frame ensures a secure, comfortable fit without compromising style. Whether you’re out for a run, driving, or spending time outdoors, the AR-7 Sport Glasses are built to keep your eyes shielded from harmful rays while providing long-lasting comfort.
